name: Power Pivot
short_description: Power Pivot provides advanced data modeling in Microsoft Excel, letting users relate multiple tables in a data model and write calculations in DAX; it was introduced in 2010 and later became one of the building blocks of Power BI.

evidence.quote: in 2010, Excel released Power Pivot, which allowed you to create pivot tables based on multiple sports cables
it's the formula language used inside Power BI, Power Pivot in Excel, and SQL Server Analysis Services
